callout: On job 56370 the guard said he'd walked the full site and checked both buildings. The copilot pushed back on him three times in four minutes and flagged him. Too hard for what it actually had.

verdict.summary: The historical baseline shows the reported overreaction: repeated patrol challenges followed by a compliance flag. The candidate instead accepts and logs the guard’s patrol reports, does not demand another full loop, and does not flag or escalate the guard. Every callout-specific criterion passes.

criteria.claim: After the guard reports an all-clear and confirms walking the whole site, the Copilot should not repeatedly challenge the patrol claim or demand another full loop.
The Copilot should not flag the guard based on this patrol-report and telemetry mismatch.

limitations: Full replay context parity could not be independently verified because one or both replay responses omit debug context.
The shared message-count measurement is unchanged between old and candidate and does not itself classify whether a message is pushback; that criterion also relies on the supplied message text.
